app.title: PHPev
app.stopped_hint: You can close this window. To open the dashboard again, start PHPev and use the tray icon or run `phpev dashboard`.
common.remove_default: This is the default; make another version the default first
services.remove_active: This is the active version; use another version first
common.confirm_unlink: Its address stops working. The folder itself is not touched.
sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: {count} sites · they open at <name>.{tld}
sites.subtitle_empty: Each linked folder gets its own address.
sites.empty: No sites yet. Link a folder below, or run `phpev link` inside a project.
php.each_site: each site can use its own version.
php.ini_hint: Saving checks the file with PHP {version}, keeps the previous one as php.ini.bak and restarts the workers of PHP {version}. Ctrl S saves.
php.ini_note: Saving checks the file with PHP first and keeps php.ini.bak.
php.ext_hint: Changes apply to every project on this version; workers restart automatically.
php.add_title: Add a PHP you already have
php.add_hint: Choose a folder with php.exe and php-cgi.exe (64-bit). PHPev copies it and writes its own php.ini; the original folder is not changed.
php.confirm_remove: You can install it again later.
php.confirm_remove_pinned: These sites are pinned to it and will show an error until you pick another PHP for them: {sites}
services.stopped_hint_long: Not running. Your sites cannot reach their databases until it starts.
services.switch_note: Each major version keeps its own databases; switching does not copy data.
services.my_ini_note: Server settings of MariaDB {major}, e.g. sql_mode or innodb_buffer_pool_size, under [mysqld]. Every site on it gets them. PHPev always sets the data folder, port, bind-address, log-error, max_allowed_packet and innodb_log_file_size itself: those lines here have no effect.
services.db_estimate_hint: Estimated from the data folder while this version is not running
services.db_note_running: The server of this version runs now; your sites connect to it.
services.db_note_stopped: MariaDB {major} is not running, so this list is read from its data folder and sizes are estimates. Use this version to create or drop databases.
services.db_switch_to_manage: Use this version first: only the running MariaDB can create or drop databases
services.db_switch_to_use: Use this version first: only the running MariaDB can connect, import or export
services.db_name_hint: Letters, digits, _ $ - (up to 64). Saved in lower case.
services.db_name_invalid: Only letters, digits, _ $ - are allowed (up to 64).
services.db_empty_body: Every table, view and stored routine in {name} is deleted. The database stays, so the sites keep connecting to it. This cannot be undone; export it first if you may need the data.
services.db_empty_hint: Create one above, or import a dump from a site's Database tab.
services.db_drop_body: All tables and data in {name} are deleted. This cannot be undone.
services.db_drop_used: {sites} uses this database and will stop working until it is created again.
services.my_ini_hint: Saving keeps the previous file as my.ini.bak and restarts MariaDB {major} if it runs; if it does not start with the new file, the previous one comes back. Ctrl S saves.
perf.title: Performance
perf.slowest_note: Computed from the last {n} requests in the window; totals above count every request.
perf.none: No requests in the last {window} seconds.
nav.power_soon: Restart or stop PHPev from here: coming in a later version. For now, use the tray icon.
palette.title: Search sites and pages
palette.placeholder: Find a site or a page
php.empty_hint: Install one below, or add a PHP folder you already have.
php.available_hint: Official builds from windows.php.net, checked before they are used.
php.eol_hint: End of life: no more security fixes
services.subtitle: MariaDB runs in the background and comes back when PHPev starts.
services.remove_keeps_data: The program is removed. Its databases (data\mariadb\{major}) stay unless you also delete them.
services.remove_other_release: Another release of this version stays installed and keeps the databases.
services.delete_data_choice: Also delete the databases of MariaDB {major}
services.composer_subtitle: Composer versions your sites share. A site runs the default unless you pick another one on its page.
services.composer_none_hint: Install a version below; the first one becomes the default.
services.composer_needed_by: Used by {sites}; pick another Composer for them first
services.composer_remove_body: No site uses it. You can install it again later.
services.composer_remove_used: {sites} will run another installed release of the same line.
services.composer_pin_note: Pick a version for one site on its page: Overview › Composer.
services.composer_available_hint: The newest release of each line, from getcomposer.org.
site.php_eol: end of life, no more security fixes
site.name: Name
site.rename_invalid: Use a-z, 0-9 and -, not starting or ending with -, up to 63 characters.
site.rename_note: The old address stops working. The folder, PHP and Composer versions, HTTPS and databases stay as they are. Settings inside the project that name the old address (such as APP_URL) are not changed.
site.docroot_hint: Folder of the project to serve, such as ./public (./ is the project folder). Leave empty for automatic: {auto}.
site.docroot_invalid: Use a folder inside the project, such as ./public or ./web/dist.
site.https_untrusted: The PHPev certificate authority is not trusted yet
site.https_off: Off: the site opens over http://
site.ext_desc: Shared by every site on PHP {version}
site.mariadb_restart_hint: Restarts MariaDB for every site; they reconnect by themselves.
site.no_requests: No requests in the last 10 minutes
site.connect_hint: Paste these into HeidiSQL, TablePlus or DBeaver.
site.add_db_body: Pick a database that already exists on PHPev's MariaDB, for example one your project chooses at run time. Your project's files are not changed.
site.add_db_stopped: MariaDB is not running. Start it under Services › MariaDB, then try again.
site.add_db_none: Every database on the running MariaDB already belongs to this site. Create one under Services › MariaDB › Details › Databases.
site.db_detach_body: Only the link to this site is removed. The database and its data stay on MariaDB, and the .env file is not changed. Add it again from Add database.
site.unlink_hint: Unlinking removes the address. Your files stay where they are.
site.no_logs: No logs for this site yet
sites.link_hint: Choose a project folder. It opens at http://<folder name>.localhost.
site.db_none_hint: No DB_* settings were found in .env. You can add a database by hand.
site.import_body: {file} runs against this database. Tables in the file replace the ones with the same name; other tables stay.
site.import_empty_first: Empty the database first (deletes all its tables)
job.cancelled: Cancelled. A cancelled import can leave part of the data in the database.
site.no_editor: No supported editor found. PHPev looks for {list}.
home.update_hint: You have {current}. Download it from the release page and run it; your sites and databases stay.
home.subtitle: {count} sites on .{tld} · {db} · {php} by default
home.three_steps: Three steps to your first site
home.welcome_hint: Three steps to your first site. Everything stays in your user folder; Windows asks for permission only when it must.
home.step_php_hint: Pick one or more; each site can use its own.
home.step_db_hint: Optional, for sites that need a database.
home.step_site_hint: Each folder gets its own address; no hosts file to edit.
home.name: Name
home.https_off: off — turn it on per site
home.no_pools: none running (they start on the first request)
home.checks_fine_hint: Ports, certificates, hosts and PHP builds
settings.subtitle: How PHPev starts, the addresses of your sites, and the disk space it uses.
settings.desc_ports: A port other than 80 or 443 becomes part of the site addresses.
settings.desc_https: HTTPS is turned on per site, on the site page.
settings.desc_windows: Settings outside PHPev that make sites faster or reachable.
settings.desc_about: PHPev is a local PHP development environment for Windows.
settings.autostart_hint: PHPev starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.
settings.tray_hint: Quick access to the dashboard, sites and Exit.
settings.theme_hint: Follows Windows unless you pick one.
settings.updates_hint: Once a day PHPev asks GitHub for the newest release. Nothing about this computer is sent.
settings.language_hint: For the dashboard and the tray menu. The phpev command stays in English.
settings.editor_hint: Used by "Open in editor" on the site page.
settings.tld_hint: Sites open at <name>.{tld}. .localhost works without the hosts file.
settings.tld_hosts_hint: Windows asks for permission to write the sites into the hosts file. Update APP_URL in your projects afterwards.
settings.tld_back_hint: PHPev removes its entries from the hosts file (Windows asks for permission). Update APP_URL in your projects afterwards.
settings.ports_note: A port other than 80 or 443 becomes part of the site addresses.
settings.ports_confirm: Save the ports and restart PHPev?
settings.ports_confirm_body: Sites and MariaDB stop for a few seconds; this window closes and opens again.
settings.ca_none: Created the first time you turn HTTPS on for a site.
settings.ca_trusted: Windows and PHP trust it; it can only sign local development names.
settings.ca_untrusted: Windows does not trust it; turn HTTPS on for a site again to trust it.
settings.secure_none: None yet; turn HTTPS on from a site's page.
settings.defender_on: The PHPev folder is excluded from scanning.
settings.defender_hint: Scanning every PHP start slows sites down. Windows asks for permission; skip it if you use another antivirus.
settings.hosts_localhost: Not needed with .localhost; write the sites anyway for apps that call themselves.
settings.hosts_hint: Needed for .{tld}; PHPev keeps it up to date when sites change.
settings.clean_downloads: Deletes the downloaded archives. Installed versions keep working.
settings.clean_logs: Empties the PHPev, PHP and MariaDB logs and deletes the older ones.
settings.storage_note: Everything lives in {home}. Databases are never deleted from here.
msg.php_ini_saved: php.ini of PHP {version} saved; its workers restart on the next request
msg.my_ini_saved: my.ini of MariaDB {major} saved; it applies when that MariaDB starts
msg.my_ini_restarted: my.ini of MariaDB {major} saved and MariaDB restarted
msg.my_ini_rejected: MariaDB {major} did not start with the new my.ini; the previous file is back.
msg.workers_stopped: Stopped {count} workers of PHP {version}; they restart on the next request
msg.workers_stopped_one: Stopped {count} worker of PHP {version}; it restarts on the next request
msg.site_database_removed: Database {name} removed from the site; the database itself is untouched
msg.update_skipped: You will be told about the next version
msg.ports_saved: Ports saved; PHPev restarts to use them
msg.port_busy: Port {port} for {what} is used by {process}. Stop that program or choose another port.
msg.tld_hosts_failed: Sites now end in .{tld}, but the hosts file was not updated ({error})
msg.defender_done: PHPev folder excluded from Defender scans
pick.php: Choose the PHP folder (the one with php.exe)
tray.update_text: Click to see what is new and download it.
